The conversation history reveals two distinct individuals with this name: William Wallace Blair (born 1828 in Holley, NY) and another William W. Blair (born 1831 in Chatham, Ontario). The Planner's instructions to the WebSurfer were too broad and did not explicitly prioritize the RLDS figure (born 1828) or provide specific disambiguation criteria (e.g., "focus on the RLDS apostle born in 1828") to ensure the correct person was identified. This lack of precise instruction led to the retrieval of conflicting data (the Ontario birthplace) in the initial search results, which the Planner later had to manually filter out. A competent planner would have narrowed the search scope immediately to avoid this ambiguity.
